statements.text: Workspace (GNW) neurons are widely distributed excitatory neurons with long-range axons, forming reciprocally connected tracts that can selectively mobilize or suppress the contribution of specialized processors.

sources.locator: Central Tenets and Neuroanatomical Basis of the GNW Hypothesis, p. 777
sources.quote: a second computational space is composed of widely distributed excitatory neurons (called GNW neurons) with long-range axons
mostly originate from the pyramidal cells of layers 2 and 3
